$comment: Install profiles for setup-consumer.sh. Each profile names SEED skills only —
resolve-skill-set.mjs expands the seeds over skill-dependencies.json, so a seed's
callees do not need listing here and must not be listed defensively: a hand-copied
closure is a second source of truth that goes stale silently.
`full` uses the sentinel "*" rather than an enumerated list for the same reason —
the set changes every time a skill is added, and an enumerated list would have to be
A skill in no profile is reachable via skills.include, and is legitimate: the long
tail (deployment, Railway, Jira sprint ceremonies, UI design) is not part of the
document pipeline. skill-dependencies-drift.test.mjs REPORTS the unprofiled set in
CI output rather than failing on it.
